semantics.primary_rule: Classify the current row's primary ontological object. Algorithms, protocol/scheme records, definitions/security games, frameworks, constructions, theses, open items, and aggregates are not theorem candidates merely because their prose mentions a property.
semantics.theorem_candidate_rule: A theorem_candidate is only a truth-valued claim candidate; it is not a claim that the current wording is correct, atomic, proved, formally checked, or benchmark-ready.
semantics.confidence_rule: Confidence concerns kind classification only, never truth or proof status.

evidence_policy.focus_truth_status_scope: Human mathematical/CS status of the repaired family as reviewed; qualifiers such as as-written, after-repair, and under-preconditions are binding.

benchmark_policy.reason: No entry has yet passed exact-statement, model, evidence, executable-oracle, rights, release-pin, split, and scorer gates.
benchmark_policy.focus_override: Every focus record repeats benchmark_eligible=false for machine-checkable enforcement.

The Bulatov-Zhuk dichotomy is for finite-domain CSPs, not merely finite fields.
The phrase ideal hash table supports O(1) lookup suppresses the probability and case semantics and is false as an unconditional worst-case claim.
Dijkstra correctness is a theorem only after the nonnegative-weight and implementation contracts are fixed.

Optimal substructure is a design principle whose truth depends on a particular problem formulation.
Huffman optimality is proved under a prefix-code model; an exact duplicate source occurrence was destructively removed from Stage0 and must remain an alias.
Emptiness, membership, and equivalence are different decision problems with different algorithms and complexity bounds.
LL(k) denotes a grammar class; a parser construction or decidability theorem requires a separate claim.
The row mixes an automaton model with a characterization theorem.
OWF existence implies P != NP, but P != NP implying OWFs is open; the source asserts the open direction.
GMR zero knowledge is a simulation-based definition, not a proved theorem by itself.
Fiat-Shamir is a transform/heuristic; security is theorem-specific and can fail without a stated model.
zk-SNARK names a protocol family, not a single theorem or scheme.

model_requirements: correctness distinct from IND security and unforgeability
records.review_basis: RSA encryption/signature correctness is elementary but the two interfaces and their security notions are not the same claim.
The title says correctness while the statement says security; these are different obligations.
CCA security is a game-based definition; a construction theorem must name a scheme and reduction.
Subject reduction is preservation, only one component of a conventional progress-plus-preservation type-safety result.
PCF full abstraction has model- and language-specific results; the phrase full abstraction problem is not one claim.
Hoare logic itself is a framework; truth-valued soundness and relative-completeness theorems need explicit scope.
Compiler correctness is a theorem schema, not an atomic claim without a concrete compiler and semantic preservation relation.
Abstract interpretation names a program-analysis framework; individual analyses and soundness theorems are separate records.

Linearizability is a correctness condition definition, not a theorem.
